about.text: Matches the storeys of several discipline models merged into one BIM Open Schema union (TKT-30). storeys reads every IFCBUILDINGSTOREY with its elevation in metres; clusters groups storeys whose elevations lie within 0.05 ft (0.01524 m) of the next one below; the steps after it flag a differing name, an elevation 0.5 mm or more off the group's median, a name used in another group, and a GlobalId shared across groups. The latest decision per row in federation-confirmations.csv sets the status; a decision with no rule row is kept as NoRuleRow. conflicts and warnings are comma-joined text, not lists, because the DuckDB table writer the sink uses (DuckDbUtils.WriteTable) cannot write list columns. The host does not seed this graph: SnowdonWorkflows.Tests fills in its three {FEDERATION_*} paths and runs it over a five-document example.

storeys.sql:
WITH project_entities AS (
    SELECT et.EntityIndex AS ProjectEntity, e.Document AS DocumentIndex
    FROM EntityText et
    JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = et.EntityIndex
    WHERE et.Category = 'IFCPROJECT'
),
project_length_unit AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, sv.Strings AS LengthUnit
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Strings sv ON sv.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:LengthUnit'
),
project_length_scale AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, env.Numbers AS LengthUnitToMetre
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Numbers env ON env.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:LengthUnitToMetre'
),
document_units AS (
    SELECT pe.DocumentIndex,
           plu.LengthUnit,
           CAST(pls.LengthUnitToMetre AS DOUBLE) AS LengthUnitToMetre
    FROM project_entities pe
    LEFT JOIN project_length_unit plu ON plu.EntityIndex = pe.ProjectEntity
    LEFT JOIN project_length_scale pls ON pls.EntityIndex = pe.ProjectEntity
),
storey_elevations AS (
    SELECT ep.Entity AS EntityIndex, CAST(env.Numbers AS DOUBLE) AS ElevationSource
    FROM Parameters ep
    JOIN Descriptors ed ON ed.rowid = ep.Descriptor
    JOIN Strings edn ON edn.rowid = ed.Name
    JOIN Numbers env ON env.rowid = ep.Value
    WHERE edn.Strings = 'Ifc:Elevation'
)
SELECT
    'storey' AS concept,
    'storey-by-elevation' AS rule,
    1 AS rule_version,
    'tolerance=0.05 ft (0.01524 m)' || CHR(59) || ' offset-threshold=0.5 mm' AS rule_parameters,
    ds.Strings AS source_document,
    et.EntityIndex AS source_entity_index,
    et.StepId AS source_local_id,
    COALESCE(et.GlobalId, '') AS source_global_id,
    et.Name AS source_name,
    lower(trim(et.Name)) AS name_key,
    se.ElevationSource AS elevation_source,
    du.LengthUnit AS length_unit,
    du.LengthUnitToMetre AS length_unit_to_metre,
    se.ElevationSource * du.LengthUnitToMetre AS elevation_m,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS target_entity_index,
    CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS axis_copies,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS claimed_room_number,
    CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS room_name_agrees
FROM EntityText et
JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = et.EntityIndex
JOIN Documents d ON d.rowid = e.Document
JOIN Strings ds ON ds.rowid = d.Title
LEFT JOIN storey_elevations se ON se.EntityIndex = et.EntityIndex
LEFT JOIN document_units du ON du.DocumentIndex = e.Document
WHERE et.Category = 'IFCBUILDINGSTOREY'

clusters.sql:
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT source_entity_index, source_document, source_name, elevation_m,
        LAG(elevation_m) OVER (ORDER BY elevation_m, source_document, source_local_id) AS previous_m,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY elevation_m, source_document, source_local_id) AS position
    FROM t
    WHERE elevation_m IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(CASE WHEN previous_m IS NULL OR elevation_m - previous_m > 0.01524 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            OVER (ORDER BY position ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS group_id
    FROM ordered
),
counted AS (
    SELECT *,
        median(elevation_m) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id) AS group_elevation_m,
        count(DISTINCT source_document) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id) AS cluster_documents,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id, source_name) AS name_rows,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id, source_document) AS document_rows
    FROM grouped
),
named AS (
    SELECT *,
        first_value(source_name) OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY name_rows DESC, source_name) AS canonical_name
    FROM counted
)
SELECT
    source_entity_index,
    'storey/' || CAST(CAST(ROUND(group_elevation_m * 1000) AS BIGINT) AS VARCHAR) || 'mm' AS cluster_key,
    canonical_name,
    group_elevation_m,
    cluster_documents,
    (elevation_m - group_elevation_m) * 1000 AS elevation_delta_mm,
    lower(trim(source_name)) = lower(trim(canonical_name)) AS name_agrees,
    document_rows > 1 AS same_document_in_cluster
FROM named

nameGroups.aggregates: min(canonical_key) as name_first_key, max(canonical_key) as name_last_key

globalIdGroups.aggregates: min(canonical_key) as global_id_first_key, max(canonical_key) as global_id_last_key

conflictList.name: conflicts
conflictList.expr: (coalesce(not name_agrees and cluster_documents >= 2, false) ? ',name-differs' : '') & (coalesce(abs(elevation_delta_mm) >= 0.5, false) ? ',elevation-offset' : '') & (coalesce(name_key != '' and name_first_key != name_last_key, false) ? ',name-in-other-cluster' : '') & (coalesce(same_document_in_cluster, false) ? ',same-document-in-cluster' : '') & (isnull(length_unit_to_metre) ? ',length-unit-unknown' : '')

answer.title: Storey correspondence
answer.columns: source_document, source_name, canonical_name, canonical_key, status, rule_status, conflicts, warnings, elevation_m, elevation_delta_mm, elevation_source, length_unit, cluster_documents, name_agrees, global_id_shared, decided_by, decided_at, decision_note, concept, rule, rule_version, rule_parameters, target_entity_index, axis_copies, claimed_room_number, room_name_agrees, source_global_id, source_local_id, source_entity_index
